notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Tokyo Mafia Simulator Development Update

Dear Community,

We know it's been a while since our last update, and we appreciate your patience. We're excited to share that the development of Tokyo Mafia Simulator is still in full swing. After gathering all your valuable feedback, we've entered a new phase of intensive development.

Our primary reason for the delay is to ensure we have enough time to add more features and polish the game to perfection. We believe this extra time will help us deliver a more immersive and enjoyable experience for all of you.

Moving forward, we plan to share more frequent devlogs to keep you updated on our progress. Your support and understanding mean the world to us, and we can't wait to show you what we've been working on.

Thank you for being such an amazing community!
